text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the cafeteria,
I ran into Wonder Acute holding a paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Just in time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of making some sweets right about now.
Would you like some to go with your tea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking there might be something I could help with,
I decided to head to the kitchen with her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first let's prepare the tools...
Oh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute-san!
Did you come here to make something, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "What a coincidence. We were also planning to spend the next two hours making Käsetorte—in other words, cheesecake."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're all here, why don't we make them together?
Let's make some delicious and cute sweets☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, what a wonderful invitation.
Well then, I believe I'll gladly take you up on it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we all ended up baking sweets together—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...There we go.
After cutting the cheese, next is, umm...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Preheat oven to 180°C.
During the 15 minutes it takes to heat up,
roll out the tart dough to 5mm.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mix the cheese with the spatula, add the sugar...
and then, next is straining it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Complete. The tart crust is done baking.
Acute-san, how is the cheese cream coming along?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho. Heave-ho and... there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer~
We have to strain it
until all the lumps are gone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
T-The pace feels completely different, doesn't it!?
...Is she gonna be okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them worked in completely different ways.
As I watched over them, wondering if it would turn out okay—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You have strained it quite thoroughly, haven't you?
—Wunderbar. What a beautiful cream.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's really no big deal.
I just figured if we're doing this, it might as well taste good.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Flash-san, I was the one
who was amazed by how skillful you were!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To be able to clean up as you cook...
There's no way I could ever pull that off, wow.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well... I believe it is the fruit of my parents' upbringing,
but I am honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Feels kinda nice?
This might actually work out well!
choice_data_list: Is it because both of you are so knowledgeable?
Maybe being so polite is something we have in common.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's true! You two are barely even looking at the recipe
while cooking, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I'm just used to it.
Once you've made it dozens of times, it's this easy~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Dozens of times...?! Eeeeek...
Fa-Falco thinks she'll pass on that~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we all decided to eat
the finished Käsetorte together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Even if the pace is different,
the care we put into it might be the exact same! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I get so carried away once I start.
I'm sorry for taking so long.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think that's a wonderful attitude.
Let's see this through together to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we all decided to eat
the finished Käsetorte together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's strange... Even though it's the usual recipe, something feels different.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely because it's packed with both
Flash-san's efficiency and Acute-san's easygoing nature☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I haven't done anything special,
but I'd be very happy if that were the case.
